If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold  add-ons for qualifying new technology services are included. If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold + the cost of any qualifying new technology services  the stay qualifies for a transfer operating outlier of 80% of the excess amount. The base transfer capital payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $900.47. The transfer capital threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $900.47. If the capital cost exceeds the transfer capital threshold  the stay qualifies for a transfer capital outlier of 80% of the excess amount.
